2000b78508043f1d.title: So Cal Bike Expo
2000b78508043f1d.desc: Three days. Two wheels. One epic outdoor expo. Set in Santa Clarita’s Central Park on Halloween weekend. 9 acres of beautiful green floor space with amazing 80 degree fall weather. Southern California is the Heart of Cycling Culture. With the opening of one of the largest public bike parks in the world and some of the region’s best cycling infrastructure, Santa Clarita is uniquely positioned to host a destination-level bicycle expo, complete with city nightlife, music, food and beverages – all within an hour of three major airports. Attendees will experience brand interactions, bike demos, group rides, a vintage bike show, evening events throughout the city, and nonstop on-bike energy from morning to night.
